title: UAP craft manipulate a subquantum information domain (Frieden's Fisher information)

tellings.quote: >> Right. I think what's happening is is I think the UAP craft are manipulating the uh the information domain because I think that there's a subquantum domain of information.

plain: Unexplained flying craft, which the government now calls UAP for unidentified anomalous phenomena, may work by manipulating a hidden layer of information beneath the smallest scale of physics. The physicist Eric W. Davis, who has advised the Pentagon, offers this as his own idea, building on the late-1990s work of the physicist Roy Frieden at the University of Arizona, set out in two Cambridge University Press books and a New Scientist magazine article on Fisher information, a way of measuring how much information data carry. "I think that there's a subquantum domain of information," Davis tells Michels, which would mean the craft control reality at its deepest level.
